interpret_setup_steps: interpret a sequence of SetupStep protobufs to execute ADB commands and sleep steps on an Android device
process_step_command: process a single SetupStep command with retry logic and success condition checks for Android setup
execute_step_cmd: execute a step command of type sleep or adb_request against an Android device via ADB
check_success_wait_for_app_screen: check success by waiting for a specific app screen to appear on the Android device within a timeout
check_install_package: check if an Android package is installed by querying the package manager via ADB with a timeout
